description: DS18 is a leading electronics manufacturer that focuses on professional audio equipment for all vehicles. Our products are designed and engineered in the USA: and, we have access to multiple factories in Korea, Brazil, and China, with select items assembled here in the USA. We are headquartered in Miami, FL, and are one of the fastest-growing companies in the area. Our company creates more than 1,000 unique pieces of professional-grade audio equipment every year. These products are distributed both nationally and internationally, with international distribution channels reaching more than 89 countries. Our consistency and dedication to our craft have netted us revenue growth levels of 300 percent over the last 3 years. We specialize in the professional development of speakers, receivers, amplifiers, components, and a plethora of other products for car audio and home audio systems.

term_and_condition:
DS18.com will not allow affiliates to bid on coupon terms or DS18’s brand/trademark. Any violations, including promoting your link and/or code on coupon sites or similar platforms, will result in immediate commission reversal and removal from the program. DS18 reserves the right to terminate this Agreement and your participation in the DS18.com Affiliate Program immediately and without notice if you commit fraud or abuse the program in any way. DS18 also reserves the right to make changes to this Site and this Agreement at any time without prior notice. By continuing to use the Site after we post changes, you will be deemed to have accepted the new Agreement.


Approval of Registration
DS18 reserves the right to approve or reject any Affiliate Program registration at our sole discretion. Rejection of your application will not entitle you to any legal recourse.


Affiliate Links and Codes
Affiliates may be assigned a unique coupon code, with details and usage specified in the Dashboard. If a customer uses both an affiliate link and a coupon code, you will receive only one commission. If you are not assigned a branded coupon, you are not permitted to promote one.

Affiliates may promote DS18 on online platforms such as Facebook and Instagram, as well as through offline channels like classified ads, magazines, and newspapers.


Commissions and Payments
You will earn a commission based on our Commission structure for any purchases made through your referral link. Commissions are calculated on the order value, excluding any additional fees such as taxes and shipping.

To receive commissions, you must provide payment details in the Settings. Payment intrusctions and guidelines will be detailed on the Affiliate Guide page.

Commissions are paid only for completed transactions. The Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy, and DS18 reserves the right to review all referral orders. Commission status is displayed in the Commission tab, and any paid commissions will be listed in the Payment tab. Commissions will not be paid for chargebacks or refunds.


Advertising Links and Codes
Affiliates must promote their unique links and coupon codes exclusively to their own audience and not within DS18’s official groups, posts, or any DS18-branded spaces. Additionally, links and codes should not be posted in any external groups, forums, or platforms where the affiliate is not an active member or in any manner that DS18 deems non-compliant with our terms. Violating this rule may result in immediate closure of affiliate links and removal from the program.


Cookies

We use cookies to track clicks on your affiliate link. If a user disables cookies or clears their cookies, we cannot track their activity or issue commissions.

The cookie duration is specified in the Affiliate registration form. Tracking begins when a customer clicks on your link or uses your coupon code. During the cookie period, any subsequent orders by the customer will earn you a commission without the need for them to click your link again.


Confidentiality of Affiliate Contract

Your affiliate contract is strictly confidential and is intended solely for you and DS18. The details, including commission percentages, payment amounts, and other terms, must not be shared publicly or privately with anyone outside of this agreement.

Sharing this information, whether on social media, forums, or in private communications, is a violation of our Affiliate Program terms and will result in the immediate termination of your affiliate account.


Removal from Program
If you wish to withdraw from the affiliate program, please contact us at SMedia@ds18.com. Please note that we reserve the right to remove affiliates from the program and void all pending payments at any time and for reasons that may not necessarily be disclosed.
